Corrected FMR coverage and source integrity

The previous parser recovered 795 rows carrying ₱14.035375B. The corrected ledger contains 964 project rows carrying ₱19.6281B: 169 more recovered occurrences and ₱5.592725B of additional extracted allocations. This is a parser correction, not a new budget-stage increase. The NEP annex contains 704 projects carrying ₱16B. Our bounded comparison independently found matching FMR annex text on PDF pages 667–726 after removing InDesign production-footer timestamps; all other content was retained.

Latitude/longitude normalization is not construction-length extraction. Straight-line distances cannot establish measured road alignment or paid scope. The cost-per-meter page now includes separately labeled approximate rates using endpoint chord distances, with coordinate review flags withheld. Only printed STA endpoints support the three stated-length rate rows below.

Potential FMR repeats: FY2027 HGAB vs FY2025 GAA

The corrected HGAB ledger is screened against locally available FY2025 enacted DA FMR records. Same qualified province and municipality are required; explicit barangay/location and direction conflicts or disjoint printed ranges veto. One best candidate per current occurrence, normalized full-title similarity ≥90%. Missing chainage and tranche differences require scope review. This is a conservative screening queue, not verified duplicate work. No FY2026 DA FMR GAA schedule is used.

Stage matching and normalization methodology

One-to-one full normalized title plus printed-region join; normalized coordinate arrays (six decimal digits) strengthen segment evidence but never define road length. Free occurrences selected by coordinate agreement, then amount difference. Already-paired titles remain ambiguous. Fuzzy titles ≥90% with qualified town/province and no explicit location/direction/tranche conflict withhold an insertion claim; they do not establish retention. Missing counterparts are review candidates, not certified insertions/removals. Imported coordinate repairs and anomalies retain all original flags.

  • Coordinates are endpoints, not measured road alignment length. Separately labeled approximate allocation-per-meter tables use endpoint chord distances; they do not supply stated road-length denominators or verified price-screening flags.
  • The NEP standalone PDF is not available locally for independent cell extraction; imported source hash and audit provenance retained.
  • Regional equality and title agreement do not certify funded engineering scope. No attribution to authors or beneficiaries.
  • The annex text equivalence check excludes production-footer timestamps only and does not authenticate either full bill.

Coordinate flags do not remove monetary allocations. One project with several coordinate segments is counted once in the monetary ledger. Imported row IDs locate records in a document; they never assert cross-document project identity.
